design_condition: Set centrally between the street and elevated railway, the building creates narrow outdoor spaces around itself while leaving the existing chestnut-tree embankment at one edge.

positive.statement: The architectural expression is coherent apart from the proposed color scheme.
The classrooms receive light from three sides and open onto attractive verandas.
The floor plans are well done overall.
The project is the most cost-effective among the shortlisted entries.
The project meets the energy requirements well.
The proposal is compact and structurally interesting.

negative.statement: The setting and symmetrical shape are not convincing between the street and elevated railway line.
The spatial relationship to the existing development and the resulting outdoor spaces appear indifferent.
Collaboration between classes is possible only through the public access area.
The multi-purpose room is too small to serve as a reserve classroom, and the desired reserve rooms are not shown.
The main rooms appear to have very limited lighting.
The central vertical circulation is too small for six classes and blocks access to the cloakrooms and verandas.
The already narrow open space is further restricted by ramps, stairs, and outdoor equipment.
The delivery arrangement and the feasibility of the outdoor equipment room are problematic.
The technical requirements are inadequately evidenced in the plans.
